name: Web Router Decoy
description: Fake internal login portal (router, NAS, VPN, webmail, admin console or Basic auth) that logs reconnaissance and credential use.

documentation.summary: The Web Router Decoy mimics vulnerable internal administration interfaces to catch rogue insiders or compromised network assets scanning the LAN for easy targets.

sections.title: Features
content: Skin Engine: TS_SKIN picks the login surface: router (default; footer matches TS_ROUTER_BRAND), nas, vpn (SSL VPN with realm), webmail, admin, or basic (HTTP Basic auth challenge). TS_SKIN_JSON defines a custom skin.
Credential Capture: Records submitted usernames; passwords are hashed by default so real credentials never land in cleartext.
Reconnaissance Logging: Page views and path probes (/admin, /.env, ...) are reported at medium severity, rate-limited per source.

sections.title: Security Architecture
content: Global Sandbox Baseline: Enforced by the TrueSignal Hub. Drops ALL Linux capabilities, enforces a read-only filesystem and no-new-privileges, and applies log rotation.
Execution Privilege: Runs as container root only so NET_BIND_SERVICE can bind ports below 1024 when configured.
Hardening: Request header/body limits and timeouts protect the decoy against slow-client exhaustion.

heuristics.recommendation_reason: Live web proxy or HTTP server detected. Deploy a fake administrative panel to catch internal network snooping and directory brute-forcing.

env_vars.name: TS_HUB_ENDPOINT
env_vars.description: The URL of your central TrueSignal Hub.

env_vars.name: TS_SENSOR_ID
env_vars.description: Unique identifier for this specific trap.

env_vars.name: TS_SEVERITY
env_vars.description: Alert severity sent to the Hub.

env_vars.name: TS_BIND_PORT
env_vars.description: Port to bind the decoy web server.

env_vars.name: TS_ROUTER_BRAND
env_vars.description: Router brand to simulate (router skin only).

env_vars.name: TS_SKIN
env_vars.description: Login surface: router, nas, vpn, webmail, admin or basic.

env_vars.name: TS_SKIN_PRODUCT
env_vars.description: Optional product name shown in the page header and title (Basic auth realm for the basic skin).

env_vars.name: TS_SKIN_JSON
env_vars.description: Optional custom skin as JSON (overrides TS_SKIN). See Docs/sensors/web-skins.md.

env_vars.name: TS_CAPTURE_PASSWORDS
env_vars.description: How submitted passwords are recorded: hash (keyed HMAC-SHA256 + length, default), plain (cleartext; avoid in PCI scope), none.

env_vars.name: TS_CAPTURE_HASH_KEY
env_vars.description: Set by the Hub: this node's capture key (derived from the Hub's master key), so password HMACs can be matched against planted honeytokens. Any value set here is ignored.
